name: Alpengold Hotel Davos
insider_take: This Alpine gem sits in the heart of Davos, where world leaders gather annually and championship skiing meets luxury hospitality in Switzerland's highest city at 5,118 feet above sea level.
whats_special: The Alpengold Hotel Davos occupies a prime location in the same town that hosts the prestigious World Economic Forum each January, transforming this ski resort into the unofficial "capital of the world" for global politics and business. The hotel's name pays homage to the region's golden Alpine light that bathes the Graubünden mountains, and guests enjoy access to one of Europe's largest ski areas with over 300km of pristine slopes.
pro_tip: Book during shoulder seasons (April-May or September-October) to experience Davos' legendary hiking trails and avoid both ski crowds and WEF security restrictions, while enjoying significantly lower rates.
dont_miss: Take the funicular railway to the Schatzalp-Platz plateau for panoramic views that inspired Thomas Mann's "The Magic Mountain," and visit the nearby Kirchner Museum to see the world's largest collection of works by German Expressionist Ernst Ludwig Kirchner, who lived and painted in Davos.
pros: Prime Alpine location in prestigious Davos ski resort
Luxury mountain accommodations with Swiss hospitality
World-class skiing and winter sports access
cons: Seasonal availability dependent on ski season
Premium pricing reflects luxury Alpine location
